sections.title: Train Ticket Amendment
sections.context: A customer is calling a rail service agent to change his travel details due to engineering works.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: Good morning, North-Western Railway customer service, Alice speaking. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Hello Alice. I'm calling because I received an automated alert on my phone about some major disruption on my journey this Friday. I'm quite concerned and I think I need to change my booking to a different day to avoid the mess.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: I'm very sorry to hear that you've been affected. There are indeed some significant scheduled works this weekend. Let's look into your options and see how we can fix this. May I start with your full name, please?

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Yes, of course. It’s Paul Henderson. That’s H-E-N-D-E-R-S-O-N.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Henderson. I've got that. And can you provide your booking reference number? It should be at the top of your confirmation email, usually a mix of five letters and numbers.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Right, let me just pull that up on my screen. I have it here. It’s X-J-4-5-9... No, wait, I’m so sorry, I’m looking at the wrong document. That was my reference from my trip to Birmingham last month. The one for this specific trip is X-J-4-5-0.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: No problem at all. Let me search for X-J-4-5-0. Ah, yes, I see it here. You are currently booked to travel from London Euston to Edinburgh this Friday, the 13th.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: That’s right. I was supposed to take the 14:00 service, which is a direct train.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: Well, the alert you received is regarding engineering works between Wigan and Carlisle. The main line will be closed for safety upgrades, and there's a replacement bus service for that section, which unfortunately adds about two hours to the total journey time.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Oh, that definitely won't work for me. I have a dinner meeting in Edinburgh that I simply cannot be late for. What if I move the entire trip to Saturday the 14th? Are the express trains running normally then?

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: Let me check the schedule for Saturday. On Saturday the 14th... yes, the express lines are open again after 6:00 AM. We have several morning slots available. There is a departure at 08:00 and another one at 09:30.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: The 08:00 is probably a bit too early for me to get to Euston. I think I'll go for the 10:00... actually, looking at my schedule again, the 09:30 would be much better. It gives me more breathing room to get to the hotel before the check-in desk gets busy.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: I've noted that down: 09:30 on Saturday. Now, regarding your seating preferences. Your original booking was for a standard aisle seat in Coach C. Would you like to keep that same configuration?

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Since I'll be traveling during the day now, I’d actually prefer a window seat if there's one available. I've heard the route through the Lake District is beautiful and I'd like to see the scenery.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: Let me see... Yes, I can get you a window seat in Coach F. It's a very quiet carriage as well. Now, because Saturday is considered a peak travel day, there is a slight fare difference. Your original ticket was a discounted weekday 'Advance' fare.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: I see. How much extra will that cost me?

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: The difference in price between the two tickets is £12.50. Ordinarily, there would also be a ten-pound administration fee for changing a booking, but because this change is due to our service disruption, we will waive that fee. So you just pay the fare gap.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: That seems very fair. I'm happy to pay that now. I was worried it would be much more expensive.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: Excellent. Just to clarify for our records, the reason for the change on our system will be recorded as 'maintenance works'. This is important for our internal reporting and to ensure you aren't charged the usual change fee by mistake.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: I appreciate that. Just a quick question out of curiosity, I heard from a colleague that the disruption was due to a signaling failure at Lancaster?

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: There was a signaling issue earlier in the week, yes, but the closure this Friday is specifically for planned track maintenance works. They are replacing several miles of old cabling.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: I see. And if I hadn't changed my ticket, where would I have had to catch that shuttle bus you mentioned?

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: Passengers traveling on Friday have to disembark the train and switch to the bus at Preston station. But since you are moving your trip to Saturday, you'll be able to stay on the train the entire way through to Edinburgh.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: That’s a huge relief. I really dislike coach travel. One last thing, how will I receive the new tickets? Do I need to go to the station office?

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: No need for that. I will send an email confirmation to you immediately. You can simply use the digital barcode on your phone to pass through the gates, or you can print it out at home if you prefer a paper copy.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: That’s perfect. You've been very helpful, Alice. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: You're very welcome, Mr. Henderson. I'll process that payment and send the email now. Have a lovely trip on Saturday!

questions.explanation: Người đàn ông đánh vần tên mình là H-E-N-D-E-R-S-O-N.
Ban đầu anh ấy đọc nhầm là XJ459, nhưng sau đó tự sửa lại thành XJ450.
Alice đề cập hành trình hiện tại là từ London Euston đến Edinburgh.
Paul chọn chuyển chuyến đi sang thứ Bảy (Saturday) để tránh sự cố.
Paul cân nhắc giữa 08:00, 10:00 và cuối cùng chọn 09:30.
Paul muốn đổi từ ghế cạnh lối đi (aisle) sang ghế cạnh cửa sổ (window) để ngắm cảnh.

questions.prompt: The fare difference to be paid is £

Lý do được ghi nhận trên hệ thống là 'maintenance works' (công tác bảo trì).

questions.explanation: Alice cho biết hành khách đi thứ Sáu sẽ phải đổi sang xe buýt tại ga Preston.

questions.explanation: Alice sẽ gửi xác nhận và vé mới qua email ngay lập tức.
